text:
ranjit: Quick sync: proposing schema change to analytics.ingest_events to add routing_policy_version (int) and quota_profile_id (string). Want to avoid console breakage. Plan: dual-write, read-adapter that maps old shape to new, then backfill. Canaries in prod for dashboards. Thoughts?

julie: +1 on dual-write. Prefer feature flag on ingest side so we can opt-in per tenant. Console should use a read-adapter layer that returns old fields when the new ones are missing.

mike: major question: partition key change? if we switch shard key to (tenant_id, routing_policy_version) we risk hotspotting. can we add indices instead of changing PK?

priya: agree with @mike. Also console quota calc reads route_meta; if we add quota_profile_id we need a transitional mapping table so quota lookups don't break.

ranjit: example SQL to start (very rough):

```
ALTER TABLE analytics.ingest_events
  ADD COLUMN routing_policy_version SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN quota_profile_id TEXT;
CREATE INDEX ON analytics.ingest_events (tenant_id, routing_policy_version);
```

sam: backfill approach: dual-write for 2 weeks, then a dedicated backfill job that scans old rows and sets routing_policy_version based on route_policy_map. Batch size 10k, sleep 200ms between batches to avoid DB p99 spikes.

ops-bot: migration job scheduled: mig-1752468000-v1 (backfill-run) -> queued

julie: notify dashboard owners (cc @growth-team @console-frontend). Add a gating rule: abort backfill if DB p99 > 150ms or console query latencies increase >20%.

mike: canary suggestion: enable dual-write for 5% of tenants in us-east-1 for 48h, monitor ingest latency, dashboard renders, and cost. If stable, ramp to 25%.

priya: for quota lookups we could maintain route_policy_map table: route_id -> policy_version, quota_profile_id. Dual-write that too so console can join against a stable table instead of per-row logic.

ranjit: good call. I'll add mapping table to the PR and include runbook steps: canary steps, rollback, metrics to monitor (ingest p99, console render p95, backfill throughput, cost). Also include a script to flip feature-flag per-tenant.

sam: rough cost estimate for backfill: ~ $300-$500 depending on concurrency. I'll refine in the PR.

julie: also add a console read-adapter endpoint that accepts both shapes; put a compatibility test in CI that runs sample dashboard queries against both shapes.

ranjit: ack. i'll draft PR today and ping reviewers. thanks all :thumbsup:
